第2186章 悟道完善掌中世界神通（第1页）
悟道，完善掌中世界神通（悟道，完善掌中世界神通（第22页）“现在修为达到合体境，六颗绝品灵晶，才能够小塔开启一年时间法则，小塔吸收这些绝品灵晶和仙石，获得的仙气，应该够我开启两百多年的时间法则。”
林浩开始闭关，在小塔中施展掌中世界神通，来参悟法则。
外面过去一百多天，林浩已经在小塔中度过一百多年。
“掌中世界神通可以吸收界海之中的天外世界力量，来增强自身，爆发出堪比半步大乘境的力量……是不是我演化的掌中世界神通，能够做到吸收天苍星域的天地力量，增强到一定的地步，就能出现一缕我能掌控的法则？”
林浩通过在小塔中一多百年的悟道，他自创的掌中世界神通有了进一步的完善，他喃喃想道：“我在界海深处学会的青龙老祖所创的两界神元功，可让自身的元力，同时拥有两个世界的力量，如果借鉴两界神元功，让掌中世界演化的场景，同时具备天苍星域和天外世界的力量，是不是我的掌中世界神通，也能吸取天苍星域的力量……。”
林浩决定将心中的猜想，进行尝试。
他在万古长生塔内，浑身五行道意弥漫，五行至尊元神的元力呼啸，来演化山川河流等场景。
只是，这次林浩演化的场景，除了在天外世界见到的山川河流，还有天苍星域见到的山川景象。
他怕大罗宗通过他的神通，来追踪来历。
林浩是将在青龙星系见到的山川河流等各种景象演化出来，并未把记忆最深处的下界天灵星等景象演化出来。
青龙星系如今已经成为一片废墟，生灵绝迹，就算林浩把青龙星系的景象融入掌中世界，也不怕大罗宗对青龙星系做什么。
“如果天外世界是更高等级的世界，那么天苍星域就是围绕着更高顶级世界的低级修真世界。”
林浩在长达近百年的悟道中，决定模仿天苍星域的格局。
大罗仙域高高在上，是个高于灵界的地方。
而林浩准备将之前演化出来的天外世界场景，来对照大罗仙域，演化出来的青龙星系场景，则是与天外世界场景对应的灵界。
林浩五行道意和五行至尊元力弥漫，在他演化的天外世界场景下方，出现青龙星见到过的连绵山川河流。
只是，当林浩想要将天苍星域青龙星的景象，与上方的天外世界场景进行交融，产生联系之时。

青龙星相关的连绵山川河流，却是在不断崩散。
“根据我的设想，我演化的天苍星域的场景，是支撑天外世界的下方世界，可以为更高级的天外世界提供力量，来增加天外世界场景的威力。”
林浩野心勃勃，企图通过借鉴青龙老祖所创的两界神光功，将演化的天外世界场景，和天苍星域场景，建立起一个上下级的世界。
一旦成功，林浩感觉自己能创立一个以天苍星域为根基，来孕育出模仿天外世界的高等级世界。
想要做到这种，光是完成雏形，都非常的难。
对天资悟性，以及对世界的了解，都要求非常之高。

The latest chapter of the Five Elements Immortal Emperor_Chapter 2186 Enlightenment and perfecting the magical power of the world in the palm of your hand Page 1_Five Elements Immortal Emperor 7200_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 2186 Enlightenment and perfecting the magical power of the world in the palm of your hand (page 1)
Chapter 2186 Enlightenment and perfecting the magical power of the world in the palm of your hand (page 1)
Enlightenment, perfecting the magical power of the world in the palm of my hand (Enlightenment, perfecting the magical power of the world in the palm of my hand (page 22) "Now that my cultivation has reached the integration state, six top-grade spiritual crystals are needed to enable the small tower to activate the law of time for one year. The small tower absorbs these top-grade spiritual crystals and immortal stones, and the immortal energy obtained should be enough for me to activate the law of time for more than two hundred years."
Lin Hao began to retreat, using the magical power of the world in his palm in a small tower to understand the laws.
More than a hundred days have passed outside, and Lin Hao has spent more than a hundred years in the small tower.
"The magical power of the world in the palm can absorb the power of the outer world in the world sea to strengthen itself, and explode with a power comparable to the half-step Mahayana realm... Is it possible that the magical power of the world in the palm that I evolved can absorb the power of the heaven and earth in the Celestial Star Region, and strengthen it to a certain point, and a ray of law that I can control will appear?"
Through more than a hundred years of enlightenment in the small pagoda, Lin Hao further perfected his self-created magical power of the world in his palm. He murmured: "The Two Realms Divine Yuan Gong created by the Qinglong Ancestor that I learned deep in the boundary sea can make my own Yuan Power, at the same time With the power of two worlds, if I draw on the divine energy of the two worlds and let the world in my palm evolve, and have the power of both the Celestial Star Realm and the Outer World, will my magical power of the world in my palm also be able to absorb the power of the Celestial Cang Star Realm..."
Lin Hao decided to put his suspicions to the test.
In the Eternal Tower of Eternal Life, his whole body was filled with the spirit of the Five Elements, and the power of the Supreme Spirit of the Five Elements roared to evolve mountains, rivers and other scenes.
However, the scene of Lin Hao's evolution this time included not only the mountains and rivers seen in the outer world, but also the mountains and rivers seen in the Celestial Star Territory.
He was afraid that Daluo Sect would use his magical power to trace the origin.
Lin Hao evolved the various scenes such as the mountains, rivers, and rivers he saw in the Qinglong Galaxy, but did not evolve the scenes such as the Celestial Spirit Star in the lower world that are deepest in his memory.
The Qinglong Galaxy is now in ruins and all life is extinct. Even if Lin Hao integrates the scene of the Qinglong Galaxy into the world in his palm, he is not afraid of what Daluo Sect will do to the Qinglong Galaxy.
"If the outer world is a higher-level world, then the Tiancang Star Territory is a low-level cultivation world surrounding the higher-level world."
During his nearly hundred years of enlightenment, Lin Hao decided to imitate the pattern of the Tiancang Star Territory.
Daluo Immortal Realm is high up in the sky, a place higher than the spiritual world.
Lin Hao planned to compare the previously evolved scene of the Outer World with the Great Luo Immortal Realm. The evolved scene of the Qinglong Galaxy was the spiritual world corresponding to the scene of the Outer World.
Lin Hao's Five Elements Taoism and Five Elements Supreme Yuan Power filled the air. Under the scene of the outer world he evolved, there appeared the continuous mountains and rivers that Qinglongxing had seen.
However, when Lin Hao wanted to blend and connect the scene of the Qinglong Star in the Tiancang Star Region with the scene of the outer world above.
The continuous mountains and rivers related to Qinglong Star are constantly disintegrating.
"According to my imagination, the scene of the Tiancang Star Domain that I evolved is the lower world that supports the outer world. It can provide power for the higher-level outer world and increase the power of the scene in the outer world."
Lin Hao is ambitious and attempts to build a superior and inferior world by drawing on the Two Worlds Divine Light Technique created by the Qinglong Ancestor to combine the evolved outer world scene and the sky star field scene.
Once successful, Lin Hao felt that he could create a high-level world based on the Tiancang Star Region to imitate the outer world.
To achieve this, just completing the prototype is very difficult.
The requirements for talent, understanding, and understanding of the world are very high.
